create_environment_instance: create an Environment instance wrapping a gym environment for reinforcement learning
run_environment_initial: run the initial method to reset the gym environment and get the first observation
step_environment_action: step the Environment with a torch action tensor to advance the gym environment
review_environment_close: review the Environment close method to properly shut down the underlying gym environment
summarize_format_frame: summarize the _format_frame function that converts numpy frames to PyTorch tensors with T,B dimensions
